assets.name: street
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production background for the existing Pink/Cocos 2D wasteland game The end. EDIT TARGET: image 1, the empty ruined street background. STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY: image 2, the approved 08 muted field-sketch characters. Do not put any characters, UI, typography, titles or sample panels into the output. Preserve image 1's location and full composition: broken shop window on left, narrow central distant alley, workshop shutter opening on right, very broad flat playable street ground in the lower quarter, quiet central fighting spaces, same camera/horizon, same proportions and main landmarks. Improve coherence with image 2: much finer restrained irregular ink contours, simple angular hand-drawn shapes and sparse flat cel-shading. Reduce small cracks, brick seams, repeated shutter lines, grain and rust spots by about two thirds, especially behind the two fighting positions at x 25% and 73%. Keep structural edges crisp and deliberate, never blurred or smudged. Background lines should be lower contrast and finer than character outlines. Use low-saturation gray olive, pale earth yellow and light brown with neutral cool overcast diffuse daylight; subdued gray-green shutter, light gray-beige plaster, taupe stone pavement, small faded ochre cloth/foliage accents. Remove the overall orange/sepia wash and photographic paper noise. Match the matte fabric/ink/value language of the approved reference characters, with enough muted midvalue contrast to separate their pale faces and ochre clothing. Foreground few restrained contour marks; no piles of new clutter, no dramatic shadows, no heavy vignette, no fog, no painted spotlight. Keep ground clearly usable and believable for feet/contact shadows. Output one clean opaque full-bleed environment texture, landscape 16:10, ideally preserve original 1586 x 992 pixel dimensions. No border, no text, no watermark, no grids. This image will be used as a real engine background, not a presentation or concept sheet.
